title: [PC, Mac, Steam] Baldur's Gate 3 $62.96 @ Steam
body:
Deal: [PC, Mac, Steam] Baldur's Gate 3 $62.96 @ Steam

[Charlie-B] Was going to pay full price yesterday but waited, the OzBargain God has blessed me.
[DRAGON6UK] Bought it a month or so back in sale for 75. This is the cheapest it's been I think ?
[CrispyChrispy] Pretty close to the ATL, it was $61.59 AUD off GOG 2 months back
[DagBateway] I managed to snag this game for just $26.99 back in 2023 is beyond me, because after a few runs, it feels easily worth $1,000.
[selphie] wow how did u get that so low then? turkey vpn or such?
[Nefe] I tried, but this is really slow to progress. And too many ways to play. You have to keep looking for guides to not miss important things in an area or things that will affect the whole game. Some puzzles are just difficult and not interesting, once again, you gotta watch walk throughs on YouTube to complete some puzzles.
If You have time to do a lot of research, this may be for you. But if you are busy or just short on patience, skip it.
[ColPow11] It is okay to play the way you would like without fear of missing bits. I know it is now how some brains are tuned, but I assure you - you can just ignore whole sections of a game, or a book, or a movie and still have a good time. If you are concerned about internal continuity, don't be - you won't miss any 'story beats' regardless of how you play this game. You might get some different content to other people because of the choices you make, but that's okay, too.
[Azro] That's actually the best way to design a game when different people get different stories of their walkthrough. Heavy Rain, for example, two people can easily get way too different experiences and that's awesome.
[Nom] It is okay to play the way you would like without fear of missing bits.
But the way he would like to play, is to not miss any bits.
[Thiefsie] I mean, thats for any serious (C)RPG really, not really anything new there. This ain't Zelda.
[Stevefgcjyyt] Played it through a couple of times as the decisions you make can have big impacts and totally change the game (unlike Bethesda games!). Highly recommend it.
[nutz4nutella] One of my favourites. Would recommend downloading the camera mod to play in third person POV.
